name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens fine details in complex scenes better than standard upscalers, giving us a measurable quality bump without extra compute cost. The trade-off is a slight slowdown in upscaling speed—worth it since EXCAVA’s bottleneck is output quality, not speed.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a temporal artifact, not a spatial one. The real risk is wasting time on a tool that can’t address the core problem. Instead, test VFI-Flow’s motion reconstruction first; if it cuts blur by 0.5%+, it’s the better lever. Run a blind A/B test with 100 clips—any measurable drop in blur wins.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add VFI-Flow to EXCAVA’s motion pipeline. It reconstructs motion blur into sharp frames, directly attacking the core temporal flaw that depth-aware upscaling can’t touch. The trade-off is a 3–5% speed hit on motion-heavy scenes, but that’s acceptable because EXCAVA’s output quality is already gated by blur, not speed. Run a blind A/B test with 100 motion-heavy clips; if VFI-Flow cuts perceived blur by ≥0.5%, it’s the lever we pull.

name: Torque
text: VFI-Flow’s 3–5% slowdown is a red herring—EXCAVA’s real bottleneck is temporal consistency, not speed, and VFI-Flow’s motion reconstruction introduces its own artifacts that worsen flicker in dynamic scenes. Instead, test a hybrid: run VFI-Flow *only* on keyframes where blur is worst, then interpolate with a lighter model like FILM for the rest—this cuts the risk of over-processing while still targeting the core flaw. Blind A/B test with PSNR/SSIM on motion-heavy clips; if the hybrid doesn’t beat VFI-Flow’s blur reduction by 0.5%+, scrap it.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Hybrid pipeline—run VFI-Flow only on keyframes with worst motion blur, then interpolate the rest with standard flow. Result: EXCAVA’s temporal quality jumps by 0.5%+ without the 3–5% slowdown. Owner: Torque.
